fixes: _load reads the account allowance from billing_periods.csv and parses the rate card numbers as exact fractions of their written decimals.
build_invoices bills every meter of the account by account position, shares the allowance over the energy lines and writes every amount as a two-decimal string.
The commitment credit now comes from the subtotal rather than from a base that rated unaccepted quantities.
_active_span replaces the day count so the standing line can be prorated per calendar month.
The exception list is sorted by read_id alone.
INPUTS names the four input files in the order the command reports a missing one.
